name: scan-time-toolchain-preflight
body: When `apg scan` selects a language whose frontend artifact is installed and whose required scan-time toolchain is absent from PATH, it reports a clear, actionable error naming the missing toolchain and the language, in place of a cryptic failure. A missing `node`/`java` reaches `Command::spawn().expect("Failed to run frontend")` (a panic); a missing `go`/`cargo` surfaces as a frontend warning or an empty graph. Acceptance: each of `go`, `cargo`/`rustc`, `java`, and `node` yields a named error with an install hint; the four frontends with an absent scan-time toolchain are unaffected. This requirement covers a language whose frontend artifact is installed; detecting a language whose frontend artifact is absent is out of scope for this change-set.
